description: A gray plastic tub with a little water and some ice sits on the table, with a small yellow cup nearby and a purple dustpan off to the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup (left-hand object), lifts it, tilts and rotates it over the tub to dump several ice pieces into the water, then tips it back upright and moves it away while the right hand stays hovering near the dustpan without touching anything.
